obligations.name: source_baseline
obligations.exit: Obtain, hash, pin, and clean-build the reported Lean sources; inventory declarations and public axioms.

obligations.name: prepared_nnf_po_free
obligations.exit: Prepared input carries normalized root and closure; sat_nnf_iff, inverse-role normalization, fragment definition, and Bool reflection are proved.

obligations.name: support_type_reflection
obligations.exit: Raw bitset support types have exact one-way Hintikka rules, complete enumeration, DecidableEq, and Bool reflection.

obligations.name: state_demand_enum_bound
obligations.exit: Raw cone states and role-aware demand codes are exhaustively enumerated with K <= N*2^N <= 2^(m+2^m).

obligations.name: transition_reflection
obligations.exit: PP, PPI, DR, PO, and EQ transition checkers reflect their Prop specifications.

obligations.name: abstract_scheme
obligations.exit: ConeScheme has a proof-independent total target function and conditional local correctness fields.

obligations.name: finite_gfp
obligations.exit: Reductive pruning is monotone, stabilizes, is greatest post-fixed, and its full Bool reflection spine is proved.

obligations.name: strategy_extraction
obligations.exit: Every accepting survivor yields a deterministic abstract ConeScheme without proof-dependent target data.

obligations.name: occurrence_freshness
obligations.exit: Indexed occurrences give every non-EQ demand a unique-parent fresh child; EQ remains local.

obligations.name: strict_order
obligations.exit: Integer-height proof that the transitive PP/PPI occurrence order is irreflexive with advertised birth orientations.

obligations.name: disjoint_geometry
obligations.exit: DR closure is symmetric, irreflexive, downward closed, and incomparable by unique component cuts.

obligations.name: protected_po
obligations.exit: Every PO birth pair remains distinct, incomparable, and nondisjoint.

obligations.name: ordered_disjoint_to_network
obligations.exit: The residual relation is a strong total converse/composition-closed abstract RCC5 network.

obligations.name: token_representation_exact
obligations.exit: Ordered tokens give nonempty sets with inclusion iff order and empty intersection iff disjointness; no topological claim is made.

obligations.name: spectrum_invariant
obligations.exit: Every actual strict-lower occurrence type belongs to the declared spectrum.

obligations.name: truth_lemma
obligations.exit: Under ForallPOFree, membership in an unfolded support type implies semantic truth.

obligations.name: scheme_soundness
obligations.exit: Every accepting abstract scheme satisfies the normalized root and hence the raw concept.

obligations.name: source_signature_static
obligations.exit: In a noncomputable proof section, every arbitrary-model point yields a locally admissible cone signature.

obligations.name: source_transitions
obligations.exit: Every source existential yields a compatible target signature for all five roles under the fragment hypothesis.

obligations.name: source_signatures_survive
obligations.exit: A predicate/Set of realized signatures is transition-closed and lies in survivors; no source-carrier Finset is formed.

obligations.name: regular_model_iff
obligations.exit: Satisfiable iff the prepared normalized root occurs in an accepting survivor signature.

obligations.name: boolean_decider
obligations.exit: coneSatCoreB is correct under the fragment proof; all sat, unsat, and outOfScope characterizations of coneCheck are proved.

obligations.name: regression_suite
obligations.exit: No-FMP, mixed-control, PO, DR, role-cache, D1, D2, and E regressions pass with kernel-accounted decision methods.

obligations.name: release_audit
obligations.exit: Pinned dual clean build; exact axiom allowlist and declaration scan; executable import/codegen checks; theorem and checksum manifests published.
